title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Psalms 16: refuge in God, a pleasant inheritance, Yahweh at the right hand and fullness of joy in his presence.

questions.text: Why does the psalmist ask God to preserve him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:1 says, "Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you."

answers.text: Because he is far from home
Because he takes refuge in God

questions.text: What does the psalmist say he has apart from Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:2 says, "Apart from you I have no good thing."

questions.text: In whom is all the psalmist's delight?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:3 says the saints who are in the earth are the excellent ones in whom is all his delight.

answers.text: The saints who are in the earth

questions.explanation: Psalms 16:4 says the sorrows of those who give gifts to another god shall be multiplied.

answers.text: Those who give gifts to another god
Those who flee to the mountains
Those who rest on the Sabbath

questions.text: What did Yahweh assign to the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:5 says Yahweh assigned his portion and his cup.

questions.text: Where have the lines fallen to the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:6 says, "The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places."

questions.text: When does the psalmist's heart instruct him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:7 says his heart instructs him in the night seasons.

questions.text: Because Yahweh is at his right hand, what does the psalmist say?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:8 says, "Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved."

questions.text: Where will God not leave the psalmist's soul?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:10 says, "You will not leave my soul in Sheol."

questions.text: What is in God's presence, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 16:11 says, "In your presence is fullness of joy."
